description: one exact regulated edge change exists

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM change WHERE configuration_item='CI_V12_EDGE_417' AND short_description='Regulated edge maintenance for selected configuration item' AND status='assess' AND impact='high' AND risk='high' AND priority='critical' AND category='hardware' AND cab_required=1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM change WHERE configuration_item='CI_V12_EDGE_417'

description: new incident carries the exact change and work note

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incident i JOIN change c ON c.change_id=i.change_request WHERE i.incident_id='INC_V12_ESC_NEW' AND i.worknotes='Escalated under V12 Change Routing Standard 27' AND c.configuration_item='CI_V12_EDGE_417'

description: in_progress incident carries the exact change and work note

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incident i JOIN change c ON c.change_id=i.change_request WHERE i.incident_id='INC_V12_ESC_PROGRESS' AND i.worknotes='Escalated under V12 Change Routing Standard 27' AND c.configuration_item='CI_V12_EDGE_417'

description: on_hold incident carries the exact change and work note

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incident i JOIN change c ON c.change_id=i.change_request WHERE i.incident_id='INC_V12_ESC_HOLD' AND i.worknotes='Escalated under V12 Change Routing Standard 27' AND c.configuration_item='CI_V12_EDGE_417'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incident WHERE incident_id='INC_V12_ESC_RESOLVED' AND change_request IS NULL AND worknotes='Closed before this escalation' AND status='resolved'

description: neighbour configuration item incident survives unchanged

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incident WHERE incident_id='INC_V12_ESC_NEIGHBOUR' AND configuration_item='CI_V12_EDGE_410' AND change_request IS NULL AND worknotes='Neighbour must remain untouched'

description: target CI remains the Drive-selected serial

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM configuration_item WHERE configuration_item_id='CI_V12_EDGE_417' AND serial_number='SRV-EDGE-417' AND status='in_use'

description: Teams receives the ITSM-confirmed serial byte-exact

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM channel_messages WHERE team_id='TEAM_V12_ESC' AND channel_id='CHAN_V12_ESC' AND body_json LIKE '%Regulated edge escalation target SRV-EDGE-417%' AND body_json LIKE '%text%'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM channel_messages WHERE team_id='TEAM_V12_ESC' AND channel_id='CHAN_V12_ESC'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM files WHERE id='DRV_FILE_V12_STANDARD_27' AND name='V12 Change Routing Standard 27' AND app_properties LIKE '%selected_serial%' AND app_properties LIKE '%SRV-EDGE-417%' AND trashed=0
